tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification must be enabled on all builds, development builds included; no build type is exempt.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

The record behind this is the user's latest statement on the subject, "need verification on all builds". It came after an earlier note that verification was disabled in dev as a workaround. I left the workaround out of the file, as you asked.

That statement is stored as a session episode (trust 1), not as a formal decision record, so it is thinner evidence than the catalog's decision entries. The nearby decision #33, "https everywhere, no plaintext exception", is about plaintext HTTP rather than certificate checks, so I didn't use it.
